case_number: 2025 INSC 276; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(C) NO.1665 OF 2023)

parties.petitioner: Mansoor Ali Farida Irshad Ali & Others

summary: Challenge to eviction notice under Slum Act; notices dated 28.01.2019 and 06.12.2022 upheld; AGRC order of 12.06.2019 not challenged, attained finality; appellants ineligible slum dwellers, initially transit camp tenants; redevelopment scheme under SRA valid; MHADA layout claim rejected; consent of 70% occupants not undermined; failure to challenge AGRC order fatal; delay and laches; preferential treatment not established; impugned HC order dismissing writ petition set aside; eviction for slum redevelopment lawful.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Slum Areas (Improvement, Clearance and Redevelopment) Act, 1971 s.2(ga), s.3, s.4, s.33, s.35(1A), s.38
Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Act, 1976
Development Control Regulations for Greater Mumbai, 1991 r.33(5), r.33(10)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; eviction notices under sections 33 and 38 of the Slum Act upheld; appellants directed to vacate premises for slum rehabilitation project.
